rule: query reached iff >=2 of 3 seeds reached. Any acceptance-audit mismatch invalidates the run. Candidates can differ from the reference only on queries whose reference post-processing was rejected (raw A* fallback), so the effect denominator is that rejected set; undecidable if it has fewer than 4 queries. A candidate is eligible iff it loses no query reached by the reference or by A* and its net query gain over the reference is >= max(2, ceil(0.25 x rejected queries)). No-regression evidence is "tested" only if at least 2 rejected queries were reached by the reference fallback; otherwise a selection is labelled "selected on gain only, regression untestable". Among eligible candidates pick highest net gain, then more accepted queries, then lower planning-time P95, then fewer lead-in attempts (k3 before k6). The straight-only ablation is never selectable.
